motorLaw: Mirror the existing positive motoring/coast law for negative duty; no battery regeneration; same 40 A limit and motor constants

signedController.description: Inverse regularized-friction feedforward plus relative-position/velocity feedback and finite rotor-current effort; no velocity assignment
signedController.nonregenerativeRule: If requested terminal power would be negative, apply a 0.001 V plugging command opposite rotor speed; zero duty remains coast

limits: New explicitly declared native contact model; never import an old-geometry capture state as fresh
Bounded planar floor dynamics only; no lift/pitch without a separate justified physical model
Finite native corridor witnesses are not continuous clearance or hardware validation
All material, friction, mass/inertia and supply values remain uncalibrated
